Hello! I'm your **Anmol Assistant**. I can help you with:

✨ Menu recommendations
🍽️ Reservations
🎉 Catering & events
📍 Location & hours
💬 Any questions about our food

What can I help you with today?

I'd be happy to help! At **Anmol Sweets & Restaurant**, we offer authentic Indian & Pakistani cuisine, traditional sweets, catering services, and more.

You can:
- Browse our [Menu](/menu)
- Book a [Reservation](/reservations)
- Explore [Catering Options](/catering)
- Try our lunch or weekend buffets

What would you like to know more about?

We're located at **Halmstad, Sweden**.

Find us on [Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/anmolsweets) for directions!
